postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Bahamas sheet dated 10/2025 states that The Bahamas do not apply a postcode system or home-delivery system. Mail is dispatched through Post Office Boxes, while Poste Restante is available to persons without a box. Post-office abbreviations such as N, GT, FX, F or AB route a P.O. Box and are not postcodes or postal-area identifiers.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No current postcode assignments exist to anchor a postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon. Islands, island abbreviations, post-office abbreviations, P.O. Boxes, Poste Restante, administrative or planning districts, localities, offices, routes, delivery points, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi or raster cells, models and AGID cells remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as postal geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, P.O. Box, post-office abbreviation, locality, optional island name or abbreviation and country separately. Do not insert a synthetic ZIP/postcode, treat a post-office abbreviation as a code or expand a P.O. Box into an area.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store P.O. Boxes, Poste Restante, post-office identity, route, service and exceptional hand-delivery products independently. The example GT 2001 contains post-office abbreviation GT plus a box number; neither component is a postcode or area key.
postal_system.administrative_rule: Preserve ISO BS and the identities of New Providence, Grand Bahama and every Family Island. Island, planning-district, electoral, local-government, settlement and postal-office identities are different layers and must not be merged or borrowed as postal assignments.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic-address identity and an explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A P.O. Box, island, office, locality, district, route, parcel, coordinate or synthetic code is not an address-to-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate a separately authorized address, box or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-current-postcode or independently typed context for BS, never manufacture a postcode or postal surface, and preserve source, version, observation time, request digest, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Separately authorized BS island, administrative, address, route, office or building evidence may be indexed only in its own authority class and never becomes a postcode or canonical postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: UPU website information may be used subject to the applicable disclaimer and source acknowledgement, while UPU copyright and database conditions restrict external duplication and do not grant bulk postal-data rights. The reviewed Bahamas ministry page and government-hosted rate book publish reference information but no resource-specific licence for a complete postcode assignment or geometry dataset. Compatible AGID processing, derivation, redistribution and public-serving rights were not established.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, customers, P.O. Box holders, Poste Restante users, delivery observations, exact addresses, coordinates, buildings, parcels, owners, occupants, query logs and land-right information require independent authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication review. None is bundled.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-current-postcode finding is time-dependent. Store retrieval time, exact editions, bytes and SHA-256, and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when the Bahamas Post Office Department or UPU announces an actual postcode release. Historical rate-book operation never upgrades itself to a current assignment release.

stages.definition: Bahamas generic address-format inventory and source links only.
Digest-bound current UPU and Bahamas authority no-postcode/PO-Box evidence plus rights, island identity, privacy and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current dated Bahamas Post Office Department or other competent-authority release putting postcodes into force and publishing a complete finite denominator of every assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object for ISO BS, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. Current UPU evidence establishes that The Bahamas applies no postcode system; P.O. Box numbers, post-office abbreviations, island names/abbreviations and Poste Restante are typed address or routing elements and never valid postcode inputs. Absence is represented as none and does not itself satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If postcodes enter into force, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, reproducible method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Islands, planning/electoral/local-government districts, administrative areas, localities, offices, routes, service areas, delivery points, P.O. Boxes, Poste Restante, addresses, buildings, parcels, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, models and AGID cells are prohibited proxies. P.O. Box, route, organization, office, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real BS API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: BS metadata and no-current-postcode policy only; no real BS Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future in-force authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts and actual BS loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a BS postal polygon. Independently licensed island, administrative, planning, route, office, address, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
